---
name: Custom request
about: A feature or change made specifically for you or your project (supporters get priority)
title: '[Custom] '
labels: custom-request
assignees: ''

---

> RJ Nexus is free and open source. Custom work and extra features are prioritized for supporters, see [Support the project](https://github.com/rj-nexus/rj-nexus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#support-the-project).
> **Do not post phone numbers, passwords, API keys or private data in this public issue.** Bigger or private requests can be sent directly (WhatsApp, Telegram or email) from the same page.

**What do you need?**
A clear and short description of the feature or change.

**Why do you need it?**
What problem does it solve for your project or your visitors?

**Request type**
- [ ] New RJBuilder widget
- [ ] Change to an existing widget (name: ...)
- [ ] Custom theme or design
- [ ] Plugin or integration (service, API, payment, etc.)
- [ ] Admin panel feature
- [ ] Migration or import from another CMS
- [ ] Performance, SEO or security work
- [ ] Other

**Supporter level**
- [ ] Proxima (bug finder)
- [ ] Sol
- [ ] Sirius
- [ ] Betelgeuse
- [ ] Vela
- [ ] Sagittarius A*
- [ ] TON 618 (sponsor)
- [ ] Not a supporter yet

**Details**
- Where it will be used: [e.g. a public page, Admin → Posts, RJBuilder]
- Examples, mockups or links to similar sites:
- Languages needed: [e.g. en, az, ru]
- Must work on: [desktop / mobile / both]

**Timeline**
- [ ] No rush
- [ ] Within a month
- [ ] Urgent (explain why)

**Scope**
- [ ] Small (a few hours)
- [ ] Medium (a few days)
- [ ] Large (a new module or system)
- [ ] I'm not sure

**Environment**
- RJ Nexus version: [e.g. 1.11.1]
- PHP version: [e.g. 8.3]
- Where it runs: [local / shared hosting / VPS]

**Should it be shared with everyone?**
- [ ] Yes, it can be added to RJ Nexus for all users
- [ ] No, it is private to my project

**Additional context**
Anything else that helps: related issues, deadlines, budget limits.
